title.value: Fast-Converging Simulated Annealing for Ising Models Based on Integral Stochastic Computing
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus of the paper is on a new method of simulated annealing for Ising models using integral stochastic computing.
title.quote: Fast-Converging Simulated Annealing for Ising Models Based on Integral Stochastic Computing

extractions.description: This paper introduces a method of fast-converging simulated annealing based on probabilistic bits (p-bits) and integral stochastic computing to solve combinatorial optimization problems, such as the traveling salesman and maximum cut problems. The proposed method demonstrates efficient convergence and scalability by searching for solutions at the global minimum energy faster than conventional methods.
